steps.warmUp: Start with the warm-up, as in every singing lesson: a few easy minutes to wake up your voice.
steps.leaps: So far the notes moved by steps. A leap skips over notes: from do up to mi leaves out re. Before each leap, hear the next note in your head, then sing it straight away, without sliding through the notes in between.
steps.doMi: Do to mi and back, then up to sol. The music waits at each note.
steps.doMiSol: Listen, then sing it in time: do, mi, sol, and back down.
steps.doMiSolAlong: The same leaps, singing along with the guide melody.
